paragraphs.text: 1. WHEN we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, and when, Most Valorous we have won the booty.
paragraphs.original: सुष्वाणास इन्द्र स्तुमसि त्वा ससवांसश्च तुविनृम्ण वाजम् ।
paragraphs.translit: suṣvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasavāṃsaśca tuvinṛmṇa vājam |

paragraphs.text: Bring us prosperity, as each desires it under thine own protection may we conquer.
paragraphs.original: आ नो भर सुवितं यस्य चाकन्त्मना तना सनुयाम त्वोताः
paragraphs.translit: ā no bhara suvitaṃ yasya cākantmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Sublime from birth, mayst thou O Indra, Hero, with Surya overcome the Dasa races.
paragraphs.original: ऋष्वस्त्वमिन्द्र शूर जातो दासीर्विशः सूर्येण सह्याः ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛṣvastvamindra śūra jāto dāsīrviśaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ |

paragraphs.text: As by a fountain's side, we bring the Soma that lay concealed, close-hidden in the waters.
paragraphs.original: गुहा हितं गुह्यं गूळ्हमप्सु बिभृमसि प्रस्रवणे न सोमम्
paragraphs.translit: guhā hitaṃ guhyaṃ gūḷhamapsu bibhṛmasi prasravaṇe na somam

paragraphs.text: 3. Answer the votary's hymns, for these thou knowest, craving the Rsis' prayer, thyself a Singer
paragraphs.original: अर्यो वा गिरो अभ्यर्च विद्वानृषीणां विप्रः सुमतिं चकानः ।
paragraphs.translit: aryo vā giro abhyarca vidvānṛṣīṇāṃ vipraḥ sumatiṃ cakānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May we be they who take delight in Somas: these with sweet food for thee, O Chariot-rider.
paragraphs.original: ते स्याम ये रणयन्त सोमैरेनोत तुभ्यं रथोळ्ह भक्षैः
paragraphs.translit: te syāma ye raṇayanta somairenota tubhyaṃ rathoḷha bhakṣaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. These holy prayers, O Indra, have I sung thee: grant to the men the strength of men, thou Hero.
paragraphs.original: इमा ब्रह्मेन्द्र तुभ्यं शंसि दा नृभ्यो नृणां शूर शवः ।
paragraphs.translit: imā brahmendra tubhyaṃ śaṃsi dā nṛbhyo nṛṇāṃ śūra śavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Be of one mind with those in whom thou joyest: keep thou the singers safe and their companions.
paragraphs.original: तेभिर्भव सक्रतुर्येषु चाकन्नुत त्रायस्व गृणत उत स्तीन्
paragraphs.translit: tebhirbhava sakraturyeṣu cākannuta trāyasva gṛṇata uta stīn

paragraphs.text: 5. Listen to Prthi's call, heroic Indra, and be thou lauded by the hymns of Venya,
paragraphs.original: श्रुधी हवमिन्द्र शूर पृथ्या उत स्तवसे वेन्यस्यार्कैः ।
paragraphs.translit: śrudhī havamindra śūra pṛthyā uta stavase venyasyārkaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Him who hath sung thee to thine oil-rich dwelling, whose rolling songs have sped thee like a torrent.
paragraphs.original: आ यस्ते योनिं घृतवन्तमस्वारूर्मिर्न निम्नैर्द्रवयन्त वक्वाः
paragraphs.translit: ā yaste yoniṃ ghṛtavantamasvārūrmirna nimnairdravayanta vakvāḥ
